name: A2 · Silhouette
premise: Refined a/final-3: a constructed head-on rider, upright as an amber outline over the shoulders, solid acid tuck with the head sunk below the shoulder line. Bike and legs are shared, so only the upper body changes.

items.title: Full, outline 48 / gap 24
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S6 1 S7 2 = 10/12 pass; S5 2. Fill 28.6%. Best 40 px rider read: pedalling legs either side of the wheel. Halo top at y=48 sits outside the central 80%.

items.title: Bust, heavy, outline 64
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 2 S4 2 S6 1 S7 2 = 11/12 pass; S5 2. Fill 35.0%, box 87%. Heaviest strokes, so it survives the blur best. The legs merge at 40 px and the halo reaches y=22.

items.title: Bust, outline 56 / gap 24
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S6 1 S7 2 = 10/12 pass; S5 2. Fill 33.4%, box 85%. Spec bust (helmet top 110, bar 600). The legs merge into one mass at 40 px.

items.title: Full, tight outline 56 / gap 0
items.note: S1 2 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 10/12 pass; S5 1. Fill 28.4%. The outline hugs the shape and reads as an amber shadow, not a before. Best margins (top y=64).

items.title: Bust, deep tuck (drop 136)
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S6 1 S7 2 = 10/12 pass; S5 2. Fill 32.4%. Head sits fully below the shoulder line, a stronger shrink. Shoulders crowd the bite at 40 px.

items.title: Full, deep tuck (drop 136)
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S6 1 S7 2 = 10/12 pass; S5 2. Fill 27.8%. As 02 with a deeper head drop.

items.title: Bust, tight outline 40 / gap 0
items.note: S1 2 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 10/12 pass; S5 1. Fill 29.6%, box 77%. Calmest version. The outline is too close to the shape to read as the before.

items.title: Bust, drop-bar hoods
items.note: S1 1 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S6 1 S7 1 = 8/12 fail; S5 2. Fill 34.5%. The drops read as table legs and add a second idea.
